prompt:
Our DevRel team needs a polished project landing page for NexusFlow ready to paste directly into our company wiki. The raw content brief is in `docs/landing_brief.txt` inside the workspace.

Please read that brief and produce the final document as `landing_page.md`. The file must contain all the sections described in the brief — title, description, install snippet, usage example, all four links (GitHub, Docs, PyPI, Discord) as clickable links, and the two sentences that mention bare release-notes and mailing-list URLs. The output must be the raw, copyable Markdown source so that anyone can paste the whole file into a CMS without any rendering artifacts.
